Carmelle Silberman I would strongly suggest to go to Misrad Hapnim on Sunday early morning and make sure that a permission for reentry is granted. If the visa is expired recently and you have no date for renewal in the computer, it isn't guaranteed that the partner will be able to enter, because they would have to issue a tourist visa for that and with what might look like an expired case in the computer, they might not do that. 
Not a great plan - staying abroad past visa expiry. It complicates things a lot because even if that review meeting happens, it will potentially raise questions about the center of life being outside of Israel.
